notes.title: Price Drop and Soundtrack Release!
notes.notes:
Great news! Attack of the Earthlings has been shortlisted for the “Best Strategy Game 2018” by TIGA!

First things first, don’t forget to vote Attack of the Earthlings for the TIGA 2018 awards  here!

Be sure to get your vote in by the deadline October 19th as winners will be announced on November 1st. 

As a thank you, we’re releasing the soundtrack by the amazing composer, Mikolai Stroinski, to everyone who currently owns the game for free for a limited time! Grab it while you can as it will be up at $4.99 from December onwards! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28988736/bf8a236bd973f47e6dd42569ecaa6904918ab3db.png

The Attack of the Earthlings full track list includes:

1. The Hu-man Cometh
2. Remember Where We Parked
3. Eyes Without Ears
4. Entry Level Position
5. Drills, Thrills & Kills
6. Party Crasher
7. An Experimental Phase
8. Severing Ties
9. Human Season
10. Making a Killing
11. Office Politics
12. Chairman of the Board
13. Hostile Takeover
14. Under New Management
15. Let's Harvest (Victory Fanfare)

We will be reducing the price of the base game from $24.99 to $19.99 USD on PC starting October 4th 2018. Now is the time to grab it if you haven’t done so already!

Stay tuned for further exciting news and updates by signing up to our mailing list here!

Thanks for all your support and happy human hunting!

notes.title: AOTE Update v1.0.6 - Controller Support
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're excited to announce that Attack of the Earthlings now has full controller support for X360, XOne & DS4 controllers. 

Linux Users please note that:

- The Xbox 360 controller (via USB) should work without issue
- The Xbox One controller (via USB) is supported with xpad 0.4 installed, please take a look at the following for more information: https://askubuntu.com/questions/783587/how-do-i-get-an-xbox-one-controller-to-work-with-16-04-not-steam
- The DS4 (via USB) will work properly when enabled/configured in Steam Big Picture

Bug Fixes 

- You can no longer bind the same key to multiple actions in the keybinding menu 

Cheers,

Team Junkfish

notes.title: VOTE: Post-Release Content
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! 

We hope you’ve been enjoying Attack of the Earthlings in its current form over the last month or so. We’re now looking to the future and deciding on post-release content, but we need your help. Please take a moment to answer our post-launch content questionnaire: 

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeqQFAB1Pl0c4yCEwKd2iBZrZDrGlJy9pcHr_lmpYU2ODgSpA/viewform?usp=sf_link

It’s a single question, and should take only seconds but it will really help us understand exactly what the community wants and where we should be focusing our efforts. 

And remember, as Dickinham would say: “Join the Junkfish family, help increase pro… ehh, customer satisfaction”

All the best, 

Team Junkfish

notes.title: Attack of the Earthlings development update.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As the development on Attack of the Earthling progressed, it became clear that our ambitions for the game was out of step with the timeframe we had set. Therefore, it is with a heavy heart that we have decided to delay the release of Attack of the Earthlings until early 2018.

One of the key reasons for this later date is that we set out with the goal of wanting to make Attack of the Earthlings more accessible for players around the world. Hence we are planning to localise Attack of the Earthlings into a number of languages.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28988736/64d82bce2179c55c3d0d6172ec7c0f34c42ebf25.png

We have also been improving the overall graphics and audio for the game as well as hoping to provide support for Mac and Linux users. 

Attack of the Earthlings will be playable at Eurogamer Expo this month and we hope to get some valuable feedback from players that we will now have time to implement before launch. If you’re in the UK and attending the show - come say hello and give us your thoughts! :)

Thank you all for your support, especially to those of you who have added Attack of the Earthlings to your wishlist! It’s massively appreciated.

We hope to update you all with how development is progressing soon. 



Thanks again,
- Team Junkfish

P.S. Don't forget to add us to your wishlists and follow us on Facebook and Twitter for the latest news and updates!
